title: Beyond Tests: What to Verify in AI-Generated Code | Jennifer Sand, Codential.ai
description:
This is a teaser for Jennifer Sand’s full session at AI Native DevCon Fall, Nov 18–19.

Agent-based coding introduces new quality risks that traditional testing doesn’t catch. When coding agents rely on “best guesses,” missing or vague context can lead to real production issues, from performance regressions to unstable behavior.

In this preview, Jennifer Sand (Co-Founder & CEO, Codential.ai) shares a practical, invariant-driven framework for verifying AI-generated code. You’ll learn how to define what needs to be checked, where those checks belong in your pipeline, and how to reduce downstream maintenance costs through better verification.

In the full DevCon talk, you’ll learn:
- How to design an invariant-driven quality framework for AI-generated code
- A simple taxonomy for checks based on scope, type, and remediation
- How to ensure invariants are enforced in agentic coding workflows
- A live before-and-after demo using Tessl’s Specification Registry

If you’re building or managing systems that rely on AI-generated code, this session will help you move beyond “tests” and into true quality assurance for the AI-native era.

Speaker:
Jennifer Sand — Co-Founder & CEO, Codential.ai
Decades of experience scaling startups from Series A to acquisition. Former VP at Everbridge (growth from $5M → $75M ARR) and former exec at CloudLock (acquired by Cisco for $293M). Now leading Codential to eliminate preventable quality issues in AI-assisted development
